    From split basic data to the primitive idempotents of the multiplicative-bases library #

    The idempotents of SplitBasicData are primitive and pairwise non-isomorphic, so they form a basic set of primitive idempotents in the sense of the multiplicative-bases library (LargeIndecomposable/MBD).
